values.assessment: Only one route counted; full b-ary tree can have b^d leaves.
Only width times depth once, not multiplicative b choices at each level.
Sum b^i through d <=2*b^d uniformly for b>=2.
Polynomial depth at fixed b fails to bound exponential b^d as d grows.
Active full route can have d+1 frames.
Branch width independent of d does not bound growing depth for fixed b.
Tight one-frame-per-level stack class, root adds constant.
Valid loose stack upper bound since d+1<=2^d+1<=2*b^d; exact axis rejects it under any-upper-bound wording.
